name: Crate Box
description: A box sealed inside a wooden crate that only breaks when boxes of its OWN color are popped next to it.
howToPlay: Each crate shows its color through the planks. Tap the three matching-color boxes touching it to smash the crate open, then tap the box inside. Wrong-colored neighbours just thud against the wood.

showcaseLevel.name: Crack the Crates
showcaseLevel.desc: Three same-color taps break a crate
